description:
Outcome: Valid one-hour court reservations belong to a real member, from README first version and owner account requirement.
Scope: Migrations, court identifiers 1-3, member user foreign key, timezone-aware hour-aligned starts, preserve existing unique court/start constraint. Existing member strings require explicit mapping; refuse ambiguous mappings and preserve data. Excludes: booking service, concurrency orchestration and UI.
Acceptance: Invalid courts and duplicate court/start rows are rejected; valid member ownership; migrations safely handle existing records.
Behaviour: Actionable mapping errors; no silent deletion or data loss.
Verification: Model constraint tests and migration tests with representative fixtures. Prerequisites: existing model T-001. Assumptions: SQLite retained; one-hour slots, configurable timezone initially UTC.
title: Court validation, ownership and safe migrations
